description: a boolean given as text is a boolean in inputs and that text in github.event.inputs
a boolean given as a JSON boolean is written true or false in github.event.inputs
a number given as text is a number in inputs and keeps the text as written
a number given as a JSON number is written as that number
a string, a choice within its options and an environment are text in both
the defaults apply to the inputs the dispatch does not give, a required one included
a given value takes the place of the default
an optional input without a default that the dispatch does not give is in neither, and github.event.inputs is null without any
an environment input takes any text until environments arrive in M3
an undeclared input is invalid_input naming it
a workflow without inputs declares none, so every input is undeclared
a choice outside its options is invalid_input naming it
